title: Yarael Poof
description: A well-respected Quermian member of the Jedi High Council in the final years of the Republic, Master Yarael Poof had two brains and four arms. He was present when Qui-Gon Jinn presented young Anakin Skywalker to the council as a vergence in the Force and that the Sith had returned to get their revenge on the Jedi once more.
